content:
Ellen (product): Quick check 11 tiny UX nits in Compliance table before we freeze the build: retention blurb wrapping, region placeholder ambiguity, KMS badge prominence, and the export affordance text. Can we surface quick fixes?
Marcus (design): Saw the screenshot. Main problems: retention wraps and increases row height, KMS pill competes visually with region, and export button looks like a destructive action (red-ish) even though it's benign.
Ravi (eng): FYI backend: export endpoint supports `?format=csv|json&since=...&cursor=...`. We can default to CSV client-side. Changing label is front-end only.
Clara (a11y): A couple of a11y items: 1) tab order currently goes Actions -> KMS -> Region which is confusing. Should match LTR visual order. 2) tooltip for BYOK must be keyboard-focusable and announced.
Ellen (product): Good notes. Marcus, propose single-line microcopy options for retention + export. Also think about showing "All regions" when none selected.
Marcus (design): Single-line options:
 - Retention: "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more."
 - Export: "Export filtered logs (CSV)"
Region fallback: show "All regions" + subtle chevron. Make Redwood-managed less prominent, BYOK pill filled with key icon.
Samira (legal): "Learn more" must point to retention policy URL with legal exceptions. Avoid wording that suggests admins can change retention unless feature GA. So no "editable" or "per workspace" yet.
Ravi (eng): Implementation notes: will reorder DOM so Region -> Retention -> Badges -> Actions to match focus. Tooltip: implement as `<div role="tooltip">` with `aria-describedby`. Export label change trivial; we'll set `format=csv`.
Clara (a11y): Tooltip details: ensure tooltip content is plain text (or links that are focusable). For the export process, add a polite live region announcing "Export starting (CSV)" when the download begins.
Marcus (design): Also a small copy variant for KMS pills: "Redwood-managed key" and "Customer-managed key (BYOK)". Tooltips: "Customer-managed key stored in your KMS." Keep them short.
Ellen (product): OK lean copy set: retention + export + region fallback + badge labels as Marcus suggested. @Samira confirm legal ok?
Samira (legal): Approved pending correct link targets. Also suggest we avoid the word "audit" in consumer-facing CTA; use "logs" or "events" consistently. So: "Export filtered logs (CSV)" is fine.
Ravi (eng): I'll open a PR later today. Plan: DOM reorder, aria attributes, copy updates, and default export format. ETA: EOD.
Clara (a11y): I'll run keyboard+SR pass after PR. Checklist: focus order, tooltip announced, export live region, menu roles for format selection.
Marcus (design): Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/klmn987/compliance-compact-v4 (view). Reduced badge contrast and adjusted spacing so single-line retention fits 48px row.
ui-bot: Figma file updated by Marcus.
Ellen (product): Thanks team. Please link PR here when ready and include screenshots of collapsed row on mobile. :thumbsup:
